notes.title: Main Build 0921 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello,[/p][p]This update includes a redesign of the train circuit, camera improvements, and performance enhancements.[/p][p][/p]
[p][b]Train Circuit[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/f0b6a54b9033cf31ce6b4996ccfae2839cea3ca3.png"][/img]The entire circuit of the train has been redesigned to resemble the actual train more closely.
The simplified logic has been removed, and all electrical interconnections like relays/contactors for each car have been implemented.
Previously unimplemented functions such as parking brake, security brake, EBS, EBCOS, ACM, and CM operations have also been implemented.
Additionally, a circuit monitoring feature has been added to check the overall status of the train’s circuits in real time.
Furthermore, a start mode option has been added, allowing the train to start in the initial startup state.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]TGIS[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/dbea64d548d5e9d663ee632337a5fb94ec7d4af2.png"][/img]You can switch to other screens by clicking on the TGIS screen.
The operation mode 2 screen for the 1000 series train has been added and can be switched using the button on the right side of the monitor.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Switchboard[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/887d1119fa22d847624d976c93adeeeb31de856f.png"][/img]The switchboard for each car of the train can be controlled.
The switches of the switchboard are linked to each car's circuit, allowing for individual car control.
This feature will mainly be used for handling faults, which will be added in the future.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]First Person Camera[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/871c8d7a05d76d5672cd802bfed397831c431264.png"][/img]
You can switch to the first person camera from the cab and walk around inside the train.
You can switch between the cab camera and the first person camera near the driver's seat.
Additionally, the shortcut for switching cab has been removed, and now you must walk to the opposite cab to switch manually.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Outside Camera[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/a7e1958f98d8344ddab1869d33135efc47f76daa.png"][/img]
The camera that views the outside of the train has been changed.
The new "Around Camera" allows you to circle the train around the vehicle.
The new "Outside Camera" allows you to move the camera position around the vehicle to view it from different angles.
For detailed camera controls, please refer to the tutorial.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Continue Playing[/b]
A feature has been added that allows you to continue playing after completing a scenario without quitting.
You can play consecutive scenarios like repeating timetables or depot entry/exit scenarios.
Additionally, the separate depot entry/exit scenarios from the basic scenario have been integrated.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Arduino Controller[/b]
An Arduino has been added to the controller settings.
Using Arduino's serial communication, you can directly link it to the game.
Serial communication rules and sample sketches can be found at [/p][p][url="https://www.jeminie.kr/Arduino"]https://www.jeminie.kr/Arduino[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Performance Improvements[/b]
Compared to the last main build, the frame rate has improved by approximately 10~20% overall.
Especially in scenes with many AI trains, such as in depots, the frame rate has improved by more than 50%.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Others[/b]
A time acceleration feature has been added, allowing you to shorten the train's startup or waiting times.
Additionally, AI trains now feature the new Saemaeul model, and the diesel locomotive and Mugunghwa model have been improved.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Main Build 1231 Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
First of all, We apologize for not updating you in a long time.
Over the course of several beta updates, we’ve made significant structural improvements.
There are many updates, and We will organize them to introduce to you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/13b8bee558f26b3a56f39594c9dddd8706246c17.png[/img]
[b]- Extension to Anyang Station[/b]
The section from Geumcheon-gu Office to Anyang (about 7 km, 3 stations) has been extended.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/dd914129dd15ed4ef4b1059fddf19431bd5017e1.png[/img]
[b]- New Scenarios[/b]
38 new scenarios have been prepared.
In particular, many scenarios involving depot entry and exit have been added, including scenarios for Imun Depot and Seongbuk Depot.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/e1e6cb29f2b4ac9df082ffaef8c1c9949c40419d.png[/img]
[b]- Timetable Mode[/b]
In addition to the prepared scenarios, a new mode has been added where you can select specific sections to play.
By selecting a departure and arrival station on the route map, the timetable for that section will be displayed, and you can play through it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/d136ce402bdb2cb668f359f99475e8fb969972c1.png[/img]
[b]- Signals[/b]
The signals have been completely rearranged with many realistic details added.
Furthermore, the signals and route control now operate dynamically.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/5d7bceb5b166b553ae2597302cab7b60419e4b87.png[/img]
[b]- AI Trains[/b]
AI trains now operate according to the real timetable, and they can complete turnarounds and depot entries and exits.
Additionally, AI trains no longer pass through player trains at signals.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/2f92925419933f6c77f3567b7f0bac33b8c49c43.png[/img]
[b]- Map[/b]
A map feature has been added to allow you to check the status of all trains and signals.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/74830e8c497e5248874fe9c5c6bc88f9aac1aac0.png[/img]
[b]- PSD Remodeling[/b]
The PSDs have been completely rearranged with many details added, now aligning with the position of train doors.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/4f4be517744faa226e50f42a7c12d2f9c4efb8e1.png[/img]
[b]- Platform Destination Signs[/b]
The platform destination signs now function and respond to all trains.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/39cbdf0c29000b3e04de61ad1835a1256fcc6c63.png[/img]
[b]- Train Remodeling[/b]
The interior and exterior of trains, including the cab, have been remodeled with more detail.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/4b4e7eff2e429c6564db246d8fd9009df7d96c6d.png[/img]
[b]- Roads[/b]
Traffic has been implemented on major roads and overpasses.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/99303e3240fe8c6e8c5f71d6849164491462589d.png[/img]
[b]- Graphics[/b]
Overall brightness has been increased to improve underground and nighttime play environments.
Platform lighting has also been newly arranged to make it look more realistic.

[b]- New Main Menu[/b]
The main menu has been redesigned, and background music has been added.


This update involved many structural improvements, making it difficult to split the main update into multiple parts.
Moving forward, we will divide tasks to ensure future main updates are not delayed.
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Switchboard Update
notes.notes:
Hello.
We apologize for the long delay in the update.
This update adds a switchboard and allows trains to start in their initial state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/3d9570b23ab7894b772a191f0a24db7381132812.png[/img]
[b]- Startup option[/b]
A new startup option has been added to the train selection screen.
Three options (initial, switchboard, complete) are available.
[b]Initial[/b] requires starting the train directly from the beginning. [b]The startup procedure can be found in the tutorial.[/b]
[b]Switchboard[/b] starts the switchboard in the preset state.
[b]Complete[/b] starts with all startups completed without a separate procedure.

[b]- Door control[/b]
In addition, the option to directly control the door has been added.
Enabling this option will no longer automatically open and close the door.
[b]How to control the door can be found in the tutorial.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/c48004ede33896311ecdf2da9ab102d49cff26f8.png[/img]
Any switch or button can now be interacted with with the mouse.
Since the number of switches on the switchboard is large, it is recommended to operate with a mouse rather than setting keys.
[b] All key settings will be reset in this update. Please check your key settings again.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325742/aed2aa0879719e305ebcf39ef854c4619253f980.png[/img]
Indoor indicators have also been added in this update.
Many other train improvements have also been made.

Thank you for waiting.

notes.title: Gameplay Improvements Patch
notes.notes:
Hello.
We are making some gameplay improvements through this patch.

[b]All settings will be reset in this patch.
Check the settings menu first before launching the game.[/b]

[b]- Camera improvements[/b]
The most requested camera improvements have been made.
The overall camera movement has been smoothed out,
Added mouse sensitivity option to control the speed of movement.
In addition, a hotkey has been added to instantly switch left/right from the cab view.

From an outside view, you can move the camera to the back of the train.
Left-click and drag to move the camera position, and right-click and drag to adjust the viewpoint.
You can return to the original position by clicking the wheel.
You can also zoom in and out and adjust the viewpoint in a fixed view as well.

[b]- UI reorganization[/b]
The menu and in-game UI have been reorganized to look better.
It's not fully finished yet, and we'll be adding loading screens, controller options, and driving log screens soon.

[b]-DLSS[/b]
Added NVIDIA DLSS option.
If you are using an RTX graphics card, you can boost performance even more with this option.
It is especially recommended for those who enjoy games in 4K or higher resolution.

In addition, the power method default setting at the start of the scenario,
Fixed the issue where announcements were interrupted when changing viewpoints.

Next is the remaining gameplay improvements, controller support, and switchboard updates.
We are also aiming to update the "Seoul Metro" train within March.
Diesel locomotives will be re-prioritized for work and will be carried out in the second quarter.
Thank you.

notes.title: Performance improvement patch
notes.notes:
Hello.
Through this patch, we will first improve the performance.
It required major structural changes inside the game to improve performance and was time consuming.
Fortunately, it turned out to be what we had hoped for.

Highlights of this performance patch are:

[b]- Initial loading time[/b]
Initial loading times more than doubled.

[b]- GPU not fully loaded [/b]
Fixed an issue that prevented the GPU from fully loading due to CPU load until previous builds.
Users with low CPU specifications or high GPU specifications can feel the sensation greatly.
(In some cases, FPS improved by a factor of two in our internal testing.)

[b]- FPS is not smooth [/b]
Fixed an issue where the screen seemed to stutter compared to FPS until previous builds.
You can feel it more sensibly.

Gameplay improvements will be updated soon.
Thank you.

[b]Patch details[/b]
- Fixed fatal ATS signal bug (not all issues have been fixed, but no more fatal issues now)
- Added a new ASOS (special operation) key (You can drive 45km from the R0 signal to the next signal.)
- Added DSD option (For those who were uncomfortable with DSD, you can turn it off now.)
- Correct the display of signals that are different from the real ones
- Changed stop warning sound (no longer beep when braking)
- Change yellow signal color / change TGIS brightness
- Ultra wide monitor support
- Uninstall SteamVR plugin


Another patch is expected this weekend.
The weekend patch includes new tutorials in all languages, key settings, stop '10' signs, and other UI improvements.
We will also post a roadmap from this week's patch to the official release.
Thank you for your interest, we will continue to monitor and improve!

notes.title: Hmmsim Metro - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Hmmsim Metro is finally out in Early Access.
Buy now![/h3]

We recommend that you drive according to your arrival time whenever possible.
You can meet other trains in their most beautiful form when running on time.
After normal operation, the following scenario will open.
There are currently [b]15 prepared scenarios[/b], and the total play time of the scenarios is about [b]5 hours[/b].

There was a slight change in the specifications.
The minimum CPU specification has been changed from i3 to i5, and the recommended specification has been changed from i5 to i7.
The capacity has also been changed from 2GB to 3GB.

Below are features that are not currently implemented.

[b]1. No loading screen yet.[/b]
When running for the first time, do not panic, wait for 5-10 seconds and the main screen will appear.

[b]2. Not many options to set.[/b]
There is no resolution setting yet, so the windowed mode is fixed at 1366x768. We will add features in the near future.
Also, you can't set the key separately yet. This will also make setting possible in the future.

[b]3. No realistic train physics effects yet.[/b]
There is no friction and drag calculation, so there is a feeling that acceleration is fast and braking is not good.
We plan to add this as an update in the near future.

[b]4. There are no English or Japanese subtitles for the tutorial yet.[/b]
The content of the tutorial video can also be improved a lot through feedback.
Along with improving the video, we plan to add subtitles as well.

There will still be many shortcomings.
Please report bugs, improvements, or ideas to the Steam community or Email.
We will continue to improve until the official release through your feedback.
